final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT pc.product_type_description, AVG(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS REAL)) as avg_qty, AVG(ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost) as avg_cost_diff FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili JOIN Products p ON ili.product_id = p.product_id JOIN Product_Categories pc ON p.production_type_code = pc.production_type_code GROUP BY pc.product_type_description), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_cost_diff) as overall_avg_cost_diff FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.avg_qty, s1.avg_cost_diff, s1.avg_cost_diff - s2.overall_avg_cost_diff as diff_from_overall FROM step1 s1 CROSS JOIN step2 s2 WHERE s1.avg_cost_diff > s2.overall_avg_cost_diff) SELECT AVG(avg_qty), AVG(avg_cost_diff), AVG(diff_from_overall) FROM step3
